subject: gk
question: According to the Ministry of Commerce and Industry 2021-22, which of the following is the largest exported agricultural product from India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rice is the largest exported agricultural product from India, contributing significantly to the agricultural export earnings.
 
• India is the world's largest exporter of rice, including both basmati and non-basmati varieties.
 
• Indian rice is highly sought after in international markets due to its superior quality and taste.
 
• The major importing countries of Indian rice are countries in the Middle East, Africa, and Southeast Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maize**

 
 
• Maize, also known as corn, is another significant agricultural product exported from India.
 
• It is primarily used as animal feed and in the production of ethanol.
 
• The major markets for Indian maize are Southeast Asian countries and the Middle East.
 
 
 
• **Spices**
 
 
• India is renowned for its spices, which are exported globally.
 
• Major spices exported from India include black pepper, cardamom, turmeric, and chili.
 
• Spices are used extensively in culinary applications, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics.
 
• The United States, Vietnam, and the United Arab Emirates are some of the largest importers of Indian spices.
 
 
 
• **Wheat**
 
 
• Wheat is a staple food grain grown extensively in India.
 
• India exports wheat to several countries, mainly in the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
 
• Wheat is used for making flour, bread, pasta, and other food products.
